name: Singapore Land Group Limited
summary: Singapore Land Group Limited operates as an investment holding company, predominantly engaged in property development for both long-term investment and active trading across Singapore and internationally. Its diverse operations are segmented into Property Investment, Property Trading, Hotel Operations, Technology Operations, and other activities. The company's property endeavors include developing and leasing commercial offices, retail establishments, and residential properties. It also provides property management services, owns and operates hotels, and invests in retail centers. Furthermore, its technology arm distributes and retails computer hardware, software, and related products, while also offering information technology, systems integration, and networking infrastructure services. Other ventures encompass investments in shares and the provision of marketing management and related services. Established in Singapore in 1963, Singapore Land Group Limited functions as a subsidiary of UOL Group Limited.
